I have excellent references for the ONEVET group. But this hospital falls a little short. At reception, they always give the excuse that the system is down, but when it's time to pay, everything is operational. My dog ​​had an ultrasound, the results were fine at the time, nothing to report. He had a CT scan, and they said I'd get the results in 2 days. It's been a week and I still haven't received the results. When we call, they always say they'll contact the doctor and he'll call back. Unfortunately, my dog ​​passed away without us knowing any results or the doctor contacting us.

The worst veterinary clinic ever. The vet was rude and refused to help our cat. He clicked his tongue and rolled his eyes at every question, slammed doors, and kept asking when we were finally going to leave. Our cat was vomiting right there in the examination room, yet we received no help and were eventually kicked out.

The way appointments are organised is a whole separate issue. When we contacted the clinic by email to complain, they told us not to come back because we were “problematic clients.” Absolutely unacceptable treatment, both towards us and, more importantly, towards our sick pet. I would never recommend this clinic to anyone.

Constant delays and ridiculously long waiting times. Whenever I go to this establishment, I always have to expect a minimum delay of 30 minutes. I strongly advise against using the service provided by this establishment.

They treated my cat very badly because she's a skittish cat. The nurse laughed and said we didn't have a cat, we had a Tasmanian devil, this after we had received a grim prognosis. My cat was heavily sedated and became very ill. They didn't have doctors to perform a necessary examination on the day of the appointment and wanted to keep her there to do the examination, God knows when, and then charge her for hospitalization. On top of that, the environment is bad inside and out, there are people doing drugs nearby, inside there's no adequate separation for dogs and cats… in short! I absolutely do not recommend it if you have sensitive cats. An emergency consultation costs around €84!

My dog's veterinarian is on vacation, but she sent me a prescription for antibiotics for my dog. I called pharmacies and they didn't have it, nor could the suppliers get it in time. I called a veterinary clinic and they could get it for Monday. To try to buy the medication as soon as possible, I called this "supposed" veterinary hospital and was told that they only sell medication if it's prescribed by their doctors. It's laughable... I really understand the criticism. You're not serving the animals; greed must be your motto.

The service was quick and impeccable, from the reception staff to Dr. Martim, who acted swiftly and decisively in response to a severe allergic reaction.

My dog ​​has been followed by the OneVet group for years and I recommend them.
They should put a security guard at the door of OneVet Porto, at least during the night. I was there between 11:30 pm and 2 am and there were two drug addicts injecting themselves next to the hospital entrance.
They treat the animals very well, in general we liked everything except the waiting times which are too long.

I took my dog ​​to this veterinary hospital in an emergency situation, completely prostrate and unable to move. Unfortunately, the waiting time was unacceptable for a case of this severity.

It's difficult to understand how a veterinary hospital that provides emergency care only has one doctor giving consultations, which ultimately compromises the speed of care and increases the anxiety of those seeking help for their animal.

The staff were polite, but the lack of resources and the delay in care do not correspond to what is expected of an emergency service. I sincerely hope that they review the organization and reinforce the team so that other animals in critical condition can be treated with the speed that the situation demands.

I would like to thank the entire OneVet team for their excellent service and professionalism. From the very first moment, I felt that my pet's well-being was the true priority.

A very special thank you to Dr. Inês Costa, who is an extraordinary veterinarian. Besides being an excellent professional, extremely competent, attentive, and dedicated, she also stands out for her immense humanity. She explained everything calmly, answered all my questions, and treated my pet with a care and empathy that made all the difference.

I was very impressed with her dedication and the way she instilled confidence in me throughout the entire process. It is very reassuring to find a veterinarian who combines a high level of knowledge with such a humane and genuinely concerned attitude towards her patients and their owners.

I highly recommend OneVet and, in particular, Dr. Inês Costa. Thank you very much for all the care, professionalism, and dedication!

Last Friday I went to the emergency room to take my baby Moon, who was in very critical condition. I listened to the professional with great care; we talked about what could happen before and after the surgery. She was very honest with me. There was nothing that could be done for my four-legged daughter. She was very honest and sincere with me, and we ended up with euthanasia, which was very painful. We ended Moon's suffering. Thank you so much to the professional for your honesty and for being with my baby at the end. Thank you from the bottom of my heart; now I know she is okay ❤️‍🩹

This veterinary hospital has excessive waiting times. The last two times I used their services, I waited over an hour to be seen. Today it was over an hour and a quarter, and I gave up. I left and I don't plan on going back to this hospital. It's worse than the National Health Service.

I couldn't have received better care. My little dog came in with seizures, and they quickly performed various tests that same day to try and find the cause. Between consultations and treatments, they managed to resolve the problem. A special thank you to Dr. Maria. She was tireless in helping my Minnie.

On April 1st, after having previously contacted the OneVet Porto hospital due to a situation with my dog, I was advised to go there. The way this instruction was conveyed clearly implied that I should go there urgently.

I then went to the hospital, arriving around 8:17 PM. At that time, only one reception area was occupied with other people, and there was no one else in the waiting room. Those people left about 10 to 15 minutes later, leaving the hospital practically empty.

Despite this, I remained in the waiting room for over an hour without any information or assistance. During that time, I observed several professionals circulating, but no one approached me.

Around 9:30 PM, after more than an hour, I got up intending to leave. I then asked them to open the door for me, and only then, when they noticed my displeasure, did the receptionist say that the doctor was about to see me, which seemed extremely convenient after so much time. I explained that I was no longer interested, as an hour's wait, in an initially urgent situation, is completely unacceptable. The receptionist simply replied "ok" and opened the door without even trying to help or minimize the situation, implying that this is a recurring issue.

I consider this experience deeply disappointing. I was not well received, there was no cordiality, and the waiting time was completely disproportionate. Considering the 85 euros I was going to pay, I do not recommend the hospital and, unfortunately, I do not intend to return, even in case of emergency. I hope this situation will be considered to improve the service in the future.

I want to express my deep dissatisfaction with this hospital.
My French Bulldog suddenly stopped walking. As soon as she started limping, I took her to her vet, who did an X-ray. The X-ray confirmed nothing was broken, but said it could be several things and advised going to this hospital. Because the orthopedist didn't have an emergency appointment (which I found strange because it was urgent for me), I had to leave her hospitalized so she could be seen in the morning. After work, I went to the hospital, and the neurologist immediately said it was a neurological problem and that if they didn't diagnose it, she could become paraplegic. She then gave me a quote of €980 to try to find the cause, which could be in vain – obviously, I panicked. I had already paid €286, and I didn't have that amount. I only saw one option: EUTHANASIA – I was devastated. I said I would take her like that without any treatment so I could say goodbye. When I was advised to get a second opinion... So it was - I went to the vet, he looked at the exams and analysis he did and gave her a strong antibiotic, and within a few hours the little thing started moving, getting up and walking crookedly but walking, and in 3 days it seemed like nothing had ever happened. It was a very difficult time for me and only those who love their animals know how much this made me suffer.
The feeling I was left with is that this hospital only cares about numbers€€€, it doesn't care much about the animals and their owners who consider them family. They could at least have given the antibiotic and taken the risk and not let us feel the pain of loss.
For me, it would only be if there were no other hospitals, but NEVER again this one.

It's easier to call Donald Trump than to go to this clinic. I don't recommend it. We chose another one.

I've been going to this veterinary clinic in Porto for a long time. I've never had any complaints about the veterinarians.

Yesterday, Monday, I went to Onevet Porto at 11:15 am with a kitten that's being treated there. The reason we went was an accident the kitten had at home; while playing, her paw got stuck in a drawer and she hung there for a few seconds. We got her out and immediately went to Onevet Porto. We explained what happened to Inês Rocha. She told us to wait. An hour and a half passed and nothing, nor would we have to wait any longer, nothing. I knocked on the door to ask, and the doctor said, "You're still busy." I asked how much longer, and the doctor replied, "You're still busy." I asked if she could open the door so we could get some air, to which she replied, "No." Then, immediately after, the person responsible for the dog that was being seen came out, asked to open the door, and Inês Rocha opened it!? Inês Rocha, learn to put a smile in your voice and be consistent. Arrogance is unpleasant and shallow. All animals deserve attention, all of them. Stop and think about your behavior. We left after 1 a.m. to go to another veterinarian. Best regards.
My pet was treated extremely well!

Today, Sunday, at 6:13 p.m., we arrived at the clinic with a dog whose leg had stopped working. It was an urgent and serious case. The lights were on at the clinic, there were three cars in the parking lot, the clinic doors were closed, and Urgencia did not answer the phone for 15 minutes.

If you say you have Urgencia, why is no one there in a difficult situation? What if the dog was dying and every minute counted?

We were helped at another clinic, where doctors are on call around the clock and always at work.

DO NOT TAKE YOUR ANIMALS TO THIS CLINIC!
I spent €1400 and didn't solve my dog's problem. They kept stalling and didn't resolve the situation; they only wanted money. I was always seen by different doctors giving different opinions, my dog ​​only got worse, and nothing was resolved! They only want money!

Here’s a polished, heartfelt high-impact review that keeps your emotion and gratitude front and center while reading smoothly and powerfully:

⸻

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Life-Saving Care and Unmatched Compassion – OneVet Porto

Our Shih Tzu, Oskar, almost died in 2023 after two veterinary hospitalizations over the course of two weeks. When he was at his weakest and we were running out of hope, we found OneVet Porto—and specifically Dra. Odete, who quite literally saved his life.

Oskar spent weeks recovering under the care of the OneVet team. During that time, they treated not only him, but us, like family. Their compassion, dedication, and constant communication meant everything during one of the most frightening periods of our lives.

More recently, over the past three months, our little girl Audrey has been very ill. After contacting the Portuguese Veterinary Board to find an endocrinology specialist, we were referred to Dra. Nina—once again at OneVet. True to our past experience, OneVet and Dra. Nina have been incredible in helping us navigate a very complex and emotional case with professionalism, empathy, and determination.

The new facilities are exceptionally clean, modern, and well organized, and the team consistently welcomes us—even without appointments—during urgent care situations as we continue through this difficult time.

We are beyond grateful for the expertise, kindness, and humanity shown by everyone at OneVet Porto.

Thank you to the entire OneVet team.
Hugs from Dr. Andre, Sr. Tomas, Oskar, Audrey, and Lucy 🤍 🐾

My experience at the VetOne Veterinary Clinic in Lordelo (Porto) was deeply disappointing in terms of professionalism and respect for the client.
During the consultation, the veterinarian left the room, I waited for some time and had to call twice. Instead of the veterinarian, assistants appeared with unclear and inconsistent excuses, while informal conversation and laughter were perfectly audible on the other side of the service door.
This situation conveyed a clear sense of disorganization, lack of respect for the client's time and devaluation of the animal's well-being, which should always be the absolute priority in a veterinary clinic.
A clinical consultation requires presence, seriousness, communication and empathy, especially when the owner is worried. Unfortunately, none of this was demonstrated in this situation.
At reception, the reaction was a bit aggressive when I asked for the complaints book, a request I reconsidered for that very reason, which was actually more positive because I remembered that most users (to whom this complaint truly matters) do not have access to the complaints book.
Therefore, I leave this review in the expectation that the clinic will urgently reassess its service standards and professional conduct so that similar situations do not happen again.

Regards,
Rafael Oliveira
